title: Consolidate button sizing scales and split chart atoms into semantic tokens for Figma library
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Reduce duplication in button sizing tokens and separate chart visual atoms into semantic tokens so teams can compose responsive, accessible components without ad-hoc overrides.

Scope:
- Audit existing size tokens used by primary/secondary/ghost buttons and normalize to a single size scale (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) mapped to spacing tokens.
- Create semantic color/typography tokens for chart atoms (axis, gridline, series-1..8, muted labels) and add clear usage guidance in the Figma library.
- Clean auto-layout constraints on button and chart components to support responsive resizing and predictable layer order for export to code.
- Publish a new library version and communicate migration steps to component owners.

Out of scope: full code migration; engineering contract work for renaming tokens in runtime will be tracked as a dependent ENG ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Single canonical button size scale (xs..xl) exists in Figma tokens and is referenced by all primary/secondary/ghost button variants.
Chart atoms are represented by semantic tokens (e.g., chart.axis.stroke, chart.series[1..8].fill, chart.label.muted) and appear in the token panel.
All affected components have auto-layout constraints corrected so text resizing and icon swaps do not overlap and export slices match expected frames.
A published Figma library file with a stable version tag and a migration note is available for the team.
Design QA checklist completed and at least two product/component owners have signed off on changes.
tasks: Audit current button tokens and produce mapping table (existing -> target semantic token)
Draft new size scale tokens and share with PM/ENG for feedback
Update button components in Figma: replace local tokens, fix auto-layout constraints, ensure icon alignment
Create new chart token set and update chart atom components
Run visual regression check in Figma (compare before/after screenshots)
Prepare publish notes and migration instructions for engineering (include token name mapping)
Publish library with version and notify slack/design-system channel
Follow up on ENG ticket for runtime token rename and coordinate rollout
